script_text: Libra, your air element is holding its breath because Saturn stations direct in your 7th House conjunct Neptune in Aries. Monday through Wednesday, Venus, your ruler, in Scorpio in your 2nd House squares Pluto in Aquarius in your 5th, making love intense and money choices deeply strategic. Tuesday is best for a private financial talk; Thursday is toughest if you overspend. Midweek, Saturn's direct station in the 7th forces a real decision in a relationship or partnership. By Friday, Mercury direct in Sagittarius in your 3rd House sextile Pluto gives you the words to negotiate better terms at work. Sunday, Jupiter in Leo in your 11th supports you through allies. Wednesday is your power day because Venus in the 2nd stabilizes your income. Friday is your worst day if old fears return. Book one honest conversation and review one budget today. Follow for daily updates.
